newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica JSE says Rex Trueform trade stands.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica JSE says Rex Trueform trade stands.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange said on Monday that a trade in Rex Trueform Ltd shares at a huge premium would not be reversed, but it was reviewing its impact on the indices and ruling price.
Syfrets Securities earlier bought 100 Rex Trueform shares, which closed at 5.30 rand on Friday, at 184 rand.
"We have spoken to the parties involved and we both agreed that we will not reverse the deal," Dannie Muton, JSE market support manager, told Reuters.
"We now have to look at what we are going to do with the ruling price and its impact on the IX58 (clothing, footwear and textile index) and the all-share index."
He said the exchange did not want the share price move to distort the market and a decision would be taken later.
Muton noted that the JSE's electronic trading system had warning devices and if traders ignored them then they would have to bear the consequences.
"The system warns them three times before putting through a transaction. If you ignore all the warnings...then you will have to pay for it," he said.
